newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Belleville, N.J..

text.p: General Obligation General Improvement Bonds, Series 1997A (Bank Qualified''

Sealed proposals will be received by the Hon. Arthur L. Minsky, Chief Financial Officer, Township of Belleville, County of Essex, New Jersey, at his office, located in the Municipal Building, 152 Washington Avenue, Belleville, New Jersey 07109 at 11:00 a.m., on

subject to the provisions of the Official Notice of Sale dated June 24, 1997 (the Notice of Sale''). Sale Date: July 17, 1997 Time: bids to be received by 11:00 a.m., award shall be by the Chief Financial
Officer prior to 11:00 p.m. on said date.
Dated Date of Bonds: July 15, 1997 Interest Payment Dates: July 15 and January 15, commencin
YEAR AMOUNT YEAR AMOUNT YEAR AMOUNT
The Bonds are subject to redemption prior to maturity as set forth in the Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement.

Denominations: $5,000 each or integral multiple thereof, as may be necessary to comply with the proposal of the successful bidder of the Bonds to accept less than the full amount of the Bonds offered officially for public sale in accordance with the Notice of Sale.

Interest Rates: The Bonds will bear interest at the rate specified by the successful bidder determined in accordance with the Notice of Sale. Each proposal must specify a single rate of interest per annum that the Bonds are to bear, in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%.
Legal Opinion: Frohling, Hudak & McCarthy, P.C.

Pursuant to Rule 15c2-12 promulgated under the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, a Preliminary Official Statement has been prepared and may be obtained from the Township. In order to assist the bidders in complying with Rule 15c2-12 (b) (5), the Township will undertake, pursuant to
the Bond Resolution and a Continuing Disclosure Certifi to provide annual reports and notices of certain events. A description of this undertaking is set forth in the
